subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Visitors board the train and wind their way through its corridors and __lavish__ decor.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lavish"** means rich, elaborate, or luxurious. (समृद्ध, भव्य, विलासितापूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** The king threw a lavish banquet for his guests.
 
 
 
• **"Affluent"** refers to having a great deal of money; wealthy. (धनी, संपन्न)
 
 
• **Example:** The **affluent** family donated a large sum to the charity.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Affluent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mundane** (सामान्य): Lacking interest or excitement; dull.

 
 
• **Example:** He led a **mundane** life, doing the same things every day.
 
 
 
• **Destitute** (निर्धन): Without the basic necessities of life.
 
 
• **Example:** The charity helps **destitute** families in the area.
 
 
 
• **Regular** (नियमित): Arranged in or constituting a constant or definite pattern, especially with the same space between individual instances.
 
 
• **Example:** He goes for a **regular** jog every morning.
